description: Elections Commission - Declare that G. R. R. Perera as a member to the Kalutara PS
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha) due to resignation, as governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
